item.title: Aston Martin’s F1 Nightmare Continues as Newey Confirms Honda Has No Spare Batteries
item.description: Problems mount for Aston Martin and Honda as a battery issue could see the team miss the race.

item.title: Max Verstappen Crashes Early in Australian GP Qualifying to Start of 2026 F1 Season
item.description: The wild start of the 2026 F1 season continues with early trouble for the four-time champion.

item.title: Casio’s Mudmaster G-Shock Gets the Toyota Land Cruiser Treatment
item.description: Casio teams up with Toyota’s Team Land Cruiser, combining rally-inspired design with triple-sensor navigation tech, solar power, and the kind of durability enthusiasts expect from both brands.

item.title: Mercedes Tops F1 Qualifying, Antonelli Rebounds From FP3 Crash
item.description: Mercedes can't hide anymore; the Russell-Antonelli duo shows their true speed in qualifying for the Australian Grand Prix.

item.title: Audi Surprises in Melbourne With a Top 10 Start on F1 Debut
item.description: Audi’s Formula 1 campaign has got off to a better start than anyone could have anticipated as Gabriel Bortoleto made the top 10 in qualifying in Melbourne – only for a glitch to stop the Brazilian showing what he could do in the final Q3 session.

item.title: David Malukas Wants to Build His Own 'Legacy' in the Iconic Verizon No. 12 for Team Penske
item.description: In Phoenix, David Malukas looks for his first win, a future "legacy" at Team Penske, and to shake his self-given nickname of 'Lil Dave'.

item.title: In His IndyCar Oval Debut, Watch Dennis Hauger Makes a Brilliant Save to Keep Off the Wall
item.description: The rookie, dubbed the 'Norwegian Nightmare', nearly saw the end of his Oval debut but instead gifted us with an epic save.

item.title: Josef Newgarden Wins IndyCar's Record Breaking Return to Phoenix Raceway
item.description: For the first time in 28 races, we have a new championship leader with Josef Newgarden's win at Phoenix and Alex Palou's DNF.

item.title: Oscar Piastri Will Not Start the Australian Grand Prix Following a Reconnaissance Lap Crash
item.description: Oscar Piastri is out of his home grand prix before it begins, following a snap and spin on his first reconnaissance lap.

item.title: George Russell is First Winner of F1's New Era, Mercedes Completes 1-2
item.description: 2026 very well may be the battle between Ferrari's start and Mercedes' speed as the two teams clearly slated themselves as the class of the field in F1's season opener.
